messages:
Olga: heads-up — nightly CI perf alert 03:12 UTC: small-batch p95 jumped ~22% on runtime v2.3.7 vs v2.3.6. saw it on A100 q4_0. summary: https://s3.redwood/bench/6054321000/summary.txt :warning:
Kevin: thanks — do we know if it's kernel-specific or broad? any quick repro?
Olga: looks concentrated on the quantized path (q4_0). attached a tiny trace excerpt: ```
[03:11:58] model_init memcpy 12.4ms
[03:12:04] token_gen p95 112ms (prev 91ms)
```
Maya: can you paste the bench command you ran? i'll run a quick local check.
Olga: bench command i used: `./bench --model gpt-small --batch-size 2 --seq 1024 --quant q4_0 --profile --commit ab12c3`
Ranjit: i'm on call and can spare a node in ~25m. which node image? ubuntu2204/gpu-driver-525?
Olga: correct — that image. i'll drop a short checklist below. cc @ci-bot for artifacts.
ci-bot: nightly-ci alert created: PERF-605432 (linked artifacts at s3://redwood-bench/6054321000/)
Olga: checklist (please reply with initials when you take a step):
1) repro on A100 with commit ab12c3 (capture bench stdout)
2) collect nvprof / Nsight timeline for the run
3) collect KV cache stats and runtime counters (kv_hits, kv_evictions)
4) capture dmesg and kernel logs if any memcpy spikes
5) upload /tmp/profiles and the bench output to s3://redwood-bench/6054321000/
6) if unrepro or inconclusive, bisect ab12c3..ab12c7 to narrow change
Kevin: i'll take 1 & 2 — running now on spare-a100-02.
Maya: i'll do 3 & 5 after i finish a CR. can you confirm the exact kv endpoint to hit?
Olga: kv counter endpoint is `http://localhost:9090/debug/kv_stats` — grab json and /metrics snapshot too.
Ranjit: starting nvprof capture now. small note: if you need p2p logs i can enable GPU p2p tracing but need sudo.
Olga: yes please capture p2p if you can. also run `sudo sysctl -w kernel.printk=7` beforehand and collect dmesg > /tmp/dmesg.out
Ranjit: ack — nvprof + dmesg + p2p logs in progress.
Kevin: quick instrumentation idea — i can add a tiny timing span around the memcpy path in runtime and push a branch; if it narrows we'll canary it. opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/rt/pull/789 (instrumentation only)
Maya: re: perf test, can we add a smoke that asserts p95 < 100ms for this exact config? that would make CI catch regressions earlier.
Olga: good idea — add to the mini-bench suite. later: if somebody volunteers a small perf test PR i'll fast-track review.
Ranjit: upload complete 03:42 UTC — nvprof, timeline, dmesg, p2p: s3://redwood-bench/6054321000/ranjit/ (files: nvprof.nv, timeline.json, dmesg.out)
ci-bot: artifact upload recorded: s3://redwood-bench/6054321000/ranjit/
Kevin: preliminary look at nvprof: high memcpy at model init and some unexpected cudaMemcpyAsync stalls around layer 6. nothing obvious in kernels themselves.
Maya: uploaded kv_stats and heap snapshot 04:10 UTC: s3://redwood-bench/6054321000/maya/kv_stats.json and heap.tgz
Olga: thanks. i'm compiling notes and will try a quick bisect locally. if someone sees an obvious runtime regression (e.g., missing prefetch logic), shout and i'll cut a canary patch.
Kevin: FYI i've pushed a tiny perf-instrument patch to that PR to help correlate memcpy windows with request ids.
Maya: done with my CR, can start bisect if you want me to.
Olga: please do start bisecting if convenient — otherwise i'll summarize findings by 08:00 PT and we can decide rollback vs fix.
eng-infra-bot: scheduled a driver-image test on staging (ubuntu2204/gpu-driver-525 -> 527) for tonight at 02:00 PT.
Ranjit: quick Q — should i also capture a kernel slab trace? might be noisy.
Olga: optional but helpful if we see dmesg churn. only do slab trace if you have spare disk to store it.
Kevin: i'll try a canary rollback on a single node after the repro completes, and run the same bench to confirm.
Olga: thanks everyone. please add short one-line updates here as you finish steps. i'll close the loop after morning collate. :coffee:
Kevin: 04:28 UTC — repro confirmed on spare-a100-02. uploading full run logs to s3.
Maya: 04:35 UTC — kv counters show a small uptick in evictions during warmup window. uploaded.
Ranjit: 04:40 UTC — nvprof shows memcpy window at init, p2p quiet. uploaded full traces.
Olga: perfect — collating. i'll post a short incident note in #incidents and link this thread. thanks all.
ci-bot: thread auto-archive scheduled in 12h of inactivity.
